notes.title: RanchLife Lives!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey dear farming friends![/b]

Many are wondering what's going on with RanchLife, is it dead? In short, no!
Ranchlife is a project close to our hearts and we have been working on it for several years now.

We also have something big to announce soon, which we are really looking forward to.

Since the development is also associated with high costs, we have prepared a Kickstarter. Please go there and activate the notification if you want to support us on our way.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dreamstudios/ranch-life]Kickstarter[/url]

RanchLife has done very well and is, among other things, much more colorful than in the trailer.
Thanks to everyone who has put it on their wishlist so far, it means a lot to us and gives us additional motivation to work hard on the game.

It is particularly important to us to release a well-rounded game that is bug-free and technically in very good condition. Quality is very important to us.

Best regards
Your Dreamstudios team

notes.title: We are there!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey dear farming friends![/h1]

We've been working on RanchLife for about 6 months.
It's [b]particularly important[/b] to us that you become a part of our game.
We also want to [b]dedicate our time to our community[/b]. We will therefore bring many events into the game as well as a lot of content that is requested by the community. Therefore we would be happy if you want to become a part of us. It would be a [b]huge support[/b] if y'all put RanchLife on your [b]Steam wish list[/b].
We will regularly expand the shop page and keep you up to date on our social media channels.

[b]Best wishes[/b]
Your Dreamstudios-team
